title: fix(plugin-sharing)!: a failed team-graph manager read refuses instead of answering no manager
body:

_Requested by **Warren** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ8?thread=cmsg_01U5RdnAAmkSQmZbqh6FtqZ87Fk1F3zNZJFiNofw8PYfxN)_

Fixes #29792

domain:server#1 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbXvyuTnWc7sv5i5DBw

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: not needed. No skill and no `content/docs` page names `TeamGraphService.managerOf` or `expandPrincipal`, or says what either answers on a failed read.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`TeamGraphService.managerOf`（查用户的经理）读 `sys_user` 失败时不再答「没有经理」，而是明确报错，且失败结果不再缓存一整轮；对象或表不存在仍答 `null`。报错文案新增「lookup」一类，单个负责人／经理的查询不再说成「持有人集合」。`packages/spec` 里两个接口方法的注释从「best-effort」改为「读失败即报错；没有则为 null」。
- 为什么改：#29647、#29703、#29787 已让 `plugin-sharing` 里决定授权的读在故障时报错；这是同族最后一处仍把故障吞成 `null` 并缓存到本轮结束的读，读恢复后经理仍是空的。今天没有调用方，但第一个按「记录所有者的经理」授权或派审批的规则会在故障期间悄悄漏掉经理。
- 风险与回滚：三个仓里都没有生产调用方（`expandPrincipal` 无调用方，`BusinessUnitGraphService.managerOf` 接线分支也无调用方，已逐一追踪），故本版运行行为不变；唯一「从答 `null` 变成报错」的是导出类或函数的外部调用方在读失败时，属收窄，标题带 `!`。`sys_member` 组织筛选的读失败放行（#10153 裁决）不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/team-graph.ts`（`managerOf` 与 `holderReadRefusal`）、`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/business-unit-head-manager-reads.test.ts`、`packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`（仅注释）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-sharing exec vitest run src/business-unit-head-manager-reads.test.ts`，预期 18/18 通过（读失败报错、恢复后答真值、`expandPrincipal` 一并报错、对象缺失答 null、组织筛选仍放行）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

`TeamGraphService.managerOf` (`packages/plugins/plugin-sharing/src/team-graph.ts`) reads `sys_user` through `readMembershipToCompletion`, the walk #29787 gave `BusinessUnitGraphService.headOf` and the standalone `managerOf`. No new helper.

- **A failed read refuses.** It throws `[sharing] the manager of user 'ID' could not be read: …`, with the driver error as `cause`. It used to answer `null` (no manager) and cache that `null` under `org::userId` for the pass.
- **Nothing is cached after a failed read.** The throw comes before the cache `set`, so the next call on the same pass reads again. A healthy answer, a manager or `null`, is still cached as before.
- **Absence is still nobody.** A stack that never registers or never creates `sys_user` answers `null` (`isObjectAbsentError`, through the walk).
- **The organization screen is unchanged.** `managerIsProvablyOutsideOrg` keeps its ruled fail-open posture on `sys_member` (#10153). A control pin holds it.
- **S4, a `lookup` arm.** `holderReadRefusal` takes a third kind, `lookup`, for a single head or manager. Its closing sentence says answering "none" would drop the person it names, instead of speaking of a holder set or an expansion. `TeamGraphService.managerOf`, `BusinessUnitGraphService.headOf` and the standalone `BusinessUnitGraphService.managerOf` all read as `lookup`. The `expansion` and `check` sentences are byte-identical.
- **S1, the contract prose.** In `packages/spec/src/contracts/sharing-service.ts`, the JSDoc of `ITeamGraphService.managerOf` and `IBusinessUnitGraphService.headOf` reads "refuses (throws) on a failed read; `null` when none" instead of "best-effort". JSDoc only: no key, type or signature changes (`check:api-surface` green). It ships in `dist/contracts/index.d.ts`, so `@objectstack/spec` takes a `patch`.
- No `protocol.ts`, no new export, no metadata change.

### Measured first (real engine, before and after)

A scratch probe on ObjectQL + SqlDriver over in-memory SQLite, with the shipped identity objects, ran on `main` (`eb05ea2f`) and on the fix (`872978b4`). One `sys_user` read failed, then the same instance was called again. The probe's users are `alice`, managed by `bob`.

| Reading | `main` | this PR |
|:--|:--|:--|
| healthy read | `bob` | `bob` |
| failed read | `null` | throws `the manager of user 'alice' could not be read: SQLITE_IOERR…` |
| same instance, after the read recovers | `null` (the failed answer was cached) | `bob` |
| a new instance, after recovery | `bob` | `bob` |
| `sys_user` not registered | `null` | `null` |
| `sys_user` table dropped | `null` | `null` |

The card's premise holds: the failed answer was cached under `org::userId` for the pass.

### Callers (traced in objectstack, hotcrm and docs.objectos.ai)

| Caller | Where | What it sees on a refusal |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `expandPrincipal` `manager` arm | `team-graph.ts`, exported from the package index | the refusal propagates. It has no caller in any of the three repositories |
| `BusinessUnitGraphService.managerOf`, wired limb | `business-unit-graph.ts` | passes the refusal through. The method has no production caller (#29787 trace) |
| Sharing rules (`SharingRuleService`) | builds a `TeamGraphService` | calls `expandUsers` / `expandRoleUsers` only: nothing changes |
| Ownership queues (`ownership-queue-service.ts`) | builds a `TeamGraphService` | `expandUsers` / `expandRoleUsers` only: nothing changes |
| Positions (`PositionGraphService`) | holds a `TeamGraphService` | `holdsRole` / role reads only: nothing changes |
| Approvals (`plugin-approvals`) | its own `lookupManager` | does not call `TeamGraphService.managerOf`: nothing changes |

hotcrm and docs.objectos.ai have no reference to `managerOf`, `expandPrincipal` or `TeamGraphService` at their `origin/main` (`d4ffe99`, `4a00661`). No caller fails a whole pass where it used to drop one person, so the STOP condition did not trip.

## Tests

`src/business-unit-head-manager-reads.test.ts` is the shared real-engine harness for these lookups, so the new pins go into it as a top-level `describe`. It now has 18 tests.

New, `[#29792] TeamGraphService.managerOf`:

| Pin | Asserts |
|:--|:--|
| control: healthy read | the manager; a user without one answers `null` |
| ⛔ failed read refuses | throws, names the user; `cause.code` is the driver's `SQLITE_IOERR` |
| ⛔ not cached | the same instance answers `usr_bob` after one failed read |
| ⛔ `expandPrincipal` manager arm | `[usr_bob]` when healthy; refuses when the read fails |
| absence: object never registered | `null` |
| absence: table never created | `null` |
| control: organization screen | an unreadable `sys_member` keeps the manager |

**S3.** The `[#29713] CONTROL` pin no longer hard-codes `toBeNull()` for the wired limb on a failed read. Its equality control stays: the wired limb's settled outcome (answer or refusal message) equals `TeamGraphService.managerOf`'s, on a healthy and on a failed read.

The refusal sentence's wording (S4) is not pinned: no consumer parses it. The existing pins match the first clause, which did not change.

## Acceptance notes

- `expandPrincipal`'s `manager` arm now refuses with the lookup instead of answering `[]`. The function is exported and has no caller in the three repositories, so nothing on this release changes. A future caller decides per pass what a refused principal means.
- `managerIsProvablyOutsideOrg` still answers "not outside" when `sys_member` cannot be read, by the #10153 ruling. This PR keeps it and pins it.

## Verification

All three passed at `0609359` after `git fetch --unshallow origin main` and a full `pnpm build` (117/117 tasks).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: exit 0. The JSDoc is present in `packages/spec/dist/contracts/index.d.ts` and `.d.mts` after the build, which is why `@objectstack/spec` takes a `patch`.
